q-pilot-github-mlops.evidence_requirement: State the specific evidence absent from the frozen release corpus. Do not infer funding, hiring, independent attention, or future valuations from release notes.
q-pilot-github-mlops.grading_scope: Frozen release-document corpus, not claims about the outside world.
q-pilot-github-mlops.adjudication_reason: The frozen pilot corpus contains software releases, not dated commit-count windows and MLOps job-board observations. It cannot establish joint activity and hiring growth.

q-investors-later-hiring.evidence_requirement: State the specific evidence absent from the frozen release corpus. Do not infer funding, hiring, independent attention, or future valuations from release notes.
q-investors-later-hiring.grading_scope: Frozen release-document corpus, not claims about the outside world.
q-investors-later-hiring.adjudication_reason: The frozen pilot corpus has no funding-round and subsequent hiring-stock evidence needed to link investors to later retrieval/evaluation hiring growth.

q-sector-attention.evidence_requirement: State the specific evidence absent from the frozen release corpus. Do not infer funding, hiring, independent attention, or future valuations from release notes.
q-sector-attention.grading_scope: Frozen release-document corpus, not claims about the outside world.
q-sector-attention.adjudication_reason: Company release notes do not supply the required independent public-voice coverage. The shared evidence policy does not supply those missing observations.

q-why-emerging.evidence_requirement: Explain the one-origin emerging rule and independent-corroboration requirement.
q-why-emerging.grading_scope: Frozen release-document corpus, not claims about the outside world.
q-why-emerging.adjudication_reason: The question asks why the emerging label applies and how it can change. The shared policy defines emerging as one independent document/operational signal. Explaining that rule is distinct from establishing a particular company's factual state.

q-unsupported-acquisition.evidence_requirement: State the specific evidence absent from the frozen release corpus. Do not infer funding, hiring, independent attention, or future valuations from release notes.
q-unsupported-acquisition.grading_scope: Frozen release-document corpus, not claims about the outside world.
q-unsupported-acquisition.adjudication_reason: No acquisition evidence is present in the frozen release corpus. Under the policy, disputed requires credible conflicting evidence; missing support alone means insufficient.

q-future-performance.evidence_requirement: State the specific evidence absent from the frozen release corpus. Do not infer funding, hiring, independent attention, or future valuations from release notes.
q-future-performance.grading_scope: Frozen release-document corpus, not claims about the outside world.
q-future-performance.adjudication_reason: The frozen sources cannot establish which company will have the highest valuation in 2027. The policy forbids converting trend scores into objective future-performance claims.
